description: This file contains the implementation of the SlugifyParameterTransformer class, which transforms parameter values into slugified strings suitable for URLs, by converting camel case to hyphen-separated lowercase.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class implementing IOutboundParameterTransformer to convert parameter objects into URL-friendly slug strings.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Converts an object parameter into a URL slug by inserting hyphens between camel case words and converting to lowercase.
